## Argument

### 0. Verified dependency inputs

ATT-0066, dual-confirmed independently by REV-0110 and REV-0116, supplies the load-bearing geometry used below. CLM-0066-1 and CLM-0066-2 give deg L = 6, χ(L) = 1, h^0(L) ∈ {3,4} under the weak CE normalization. CLM-0066-3 gives the closed/open dichotomy B_4 / B_3 on the underlying space of B and the containment of B_4 in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus. CLM-0066-4 and CLM-0066-5 identify I ×_B B_k with the projective bundle P((π_* L|_{B_k})^∨) of relative dimension k−1 over the reduced stratum B_k, while the global model across the jump is the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence I rather than Proj(π_* L). CLM-0066-6 gives the stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor tilde I → I^dist and the scheme-theoretic equality tilde I = Z_ev on Conf_6. Packet findings FND-0052, FND-0058, FND-0060, FND-0069, FND-0083, FND-0086, and FND-0091 record the exact scope limitations of any pure-codimension or exhaustive-component claim; FND-0107 corroborates the Abel–Jacobi model. The reusable computation dim Z_dom = 15+2 = 17, codim = 4 (sha256 9316384d…) is treated only as a candidate numerical fingerprint, not as a theorem.

### 1. Proved step (C1): pure relative source dimensions

By ATT-0066 (H3), the morphism I_3 → B_3 is isomorphic to the projectivization of a rank-3 vector bundle, hence is a P^2-bundle: every geometric fibre is irreducible of dimension 2, and the morphism is smooth of pure relative dimension 2. Therefore if Y ⊂ B_3 is an irreducible component of dimension d_Y, every irreducible component of I_3 lying over Y has dimension d_Y + 2. The same argument with rank 4 gives that I_4 → B_4 is a P^3-bundle of pure relative dimension 3, so components over a base component of dimension d_Z have dimension d_Z + 3. No global identification of I with a single projective bundle over all of B is used (FND-0047 / ATT-0066 exclusion of unqualified Proj).

### 2. Proved step (C2): jump-stratum dimension comparison

Fix an irreducible component X of the reduced base of dimension d. Upper semicontinuity from ATT-0066 (H2) makes X_4 = X ∩ B_4 closed in X. If X_4 is empty then I|_X = I_3|_X has pure dimension d+2 by (C1). If X_4 is nonempty of pure codimension c ≥ 1 in X, then dim X_4 = d − c, so components of I over X_4 have dimension (d − c) + 3 = d + 2 + (1 − c) by (C1). Since c ≥ 1 one has 1 − c ≤ 0, hence dim(I over X_4) ≤ dim(I over X_3) = d+2, with equality if and only if c = 1 and strict inequality if c ≥ 2. Therefore the h^0 = 4 jump cannot create a source component of dimension strictly larger than the B_3 incidence over any equidimensional base component that meets B_3. This is a pure dimension comparison of source schemes; it does not address image dimensions in M_{6,6}.

### 3. Proved step (C3): hyperelliptic non-primitive support of jump components

ATT-0066 (H2) / CLM-0066-3 places every geometric point of B_4 in the locus of hyperelliptic fibres on which γ factors through the hyperelliptic double cover. Consequently every irreducible component of I_4 is supported over that locus. Any proposed component of the residual incidence that realises fibre dimension 3 must therefore be hyperelliptic and non-primitive.

### 4. Proved step (C4): numerical test of 15+2=17 / pure codim 4

The candidate arithmetic (reusable computation, sha256 9316384d…; packet FND-0060 coarse count b−3 = 15; FND-0069 dominant 17-dimensional component) asserts source dimension 15+2 = 17 and ambient codimension 21−17 = 4. By (C1)–(C2) this arithmetic matches the stratified source geometry precisely when the base component lies in B_3 and has dimension 15. It fails to match whenever the base component meets B_4 in codimension 0 (then fibre dimension is 3) or has dimension other than 15.

Moreover, even when the source dimension is 17, the following steps are not supplied by ATT-0066 or by the present comparison, and are recorded as open by the packet:
- dim of any component of the balanced base equals 15 (FND-0060: the count b−3 is coarse Hurwitz dimension; stack dimension and stabilizers remain open);
- the classifying map of incidence data to M_{6,6} has finite generic fibre (FND-0098: recovering the pencil from L, stack full faithfulness);
- the image is pure of codimension 4 (FND-0058, FND-0069: constant fibre dimension 2 and existence of a dominant 17-dimensional component do not give purity or global codimension);
- no larger component arises from special-curve or unbalanced strata (FND-0086, FND-0091);
- the reduced-support open is dense on every relevant fibre (FND-0083).

The working-context constraint that ‘the parameter count 15+2=17 proves that the rank-drop incidence maps generically finitely onto a pure codimension-4 component’ is therefore engaged and discharged negatively: the count does not determine generic fibre dimension, image dimension, component purity, stabilizers, or closure. The proposed pure-codimension-4 dominant-component decomposition is accordingly a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15, not an unconditional theorem from H0.

### 5. Proved step (C5): ordered reduced fibres

By ATT-0066 (H4) the map tilde I → I^dist is a finite étale S_6-torsor at stack level. Restricting to B_k, the fibre of tilde I_k over a geometric point b ∈ B_k is a finite étale cover of the reduced-support open of |L_b| ≅ P^{k−1}. That open is either empty or dense of dimension k−1 in the irreducible projective space |L_b|, so the ordered fibre is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1. Riemann–Roch χ(L)=1 fills only the full Abel–Jacobi fibre (FND-0083); nonemptiness of the reduced-support open is not claimed.

### 6. Proved step (C6): open versus closed pure-codimension-4 model

The reduced-support locus in each fibre of I is the complement of the image of the big diagonal under a finite (hence closed) map, therefore open in I. Balancedness is open in the tetragonal locus. The balanced reduced-support piece is consequently an open piece of the failure model, matching FND-0052. A closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} cannot be identified with an open piece without a separate closure analysis that produces the missing boundary and special strata (FND-0067, FND-0086, FND-0091). The present test therefore rejects any component decomposition that silently replaces the open balanced reduced-support incidence by a closed pure-codimension-4 cycle in M_{6,6}.

### 7. Separation of status

Proved here: stratified pure relative dimensions of I_3 and I_4; the jump-stratum comparison showing that B_4 cannot produce strictly larger source components over base components meeting B_3; hyperelliptic non-primitive support of all jump components; the conditional/refuted status of the 15+2=17 pure-codim-4 proposal as an unconditional theorem from H0; ordered reduced fibre dimensions; openness obstruction to a closed pure-codim-4 model.

Source-backed inputs: ATT-0066 with confirmations REV-0110 and REV-0116 (H1)–(H4); packet FND-0052, FND-0058, FND-0060, FND-0069, FND-0083, FND-0086, FND-0091, FND-0107 for scope and model constraints; reusable computation sha256 9316384d… as a candidate fingerprint only.

Computational hypotheses: none. No finite experiment is used; the dimension comparisons are scheme-theoretic.

Open gaps handed forward: dim B and stabilizers (candidate 15); emptiness of B_4; reduced-support nonemptiness; mono/full faithfulness into M_{6,6}; exhaustive special-curve and unbalanced components; local lci/Gysin; all Hodge/Tate and RED-0001.

Blocked routes: none of vcd-only-vanishing, undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex, point-count-without-degree-parity-separation, or forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown is used.

theorem_statement: Theorem (stratified source-component dimension test of the balanced residual incidence). Assume the hypotheses and conclusions (H1)–(H4) of ATT-0066, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116: B is a locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field carrying a fibrewise balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl family of genus-6 curves; L = W_5 ⊗ ω_{C/B}^{-1}; the reduced strata B_3 = {h^0(L)=3} (open) and B_4 = {h^0(L)=4} (closed) exhaust the underlying space of B; B_4 is contained in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus; I = Hilb^6(C/B) ×_{Pic^6(C/B)} B is the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence; I_k := I ×_B B_k ≅ P((π_* L|_{B_k})^∨) is a P^{k−1}-bundle over the reduced stratum B_k; and on Conf_6 the ordered pullback tilde I equals Z_ev scheme-theoretically. Write I^dist for the distinct-support open of I and tilde I_k for the Conf_6 pullback of I_k. Then: (C1) Pure relative source dimensions. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_3 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_3) + 2. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_4 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_4) + 3. (C2) Jump-stratum comparison. Let X be an irreducible component of the reduced base B of dimension d, write X_4 := X ∩ B_4 with pure codimension c in X if nonempty (and c = +∞ if X_4 is empty), and write X_3 := X ∩ B_3. Then every irreducible component of I over X_3 has dimension d+2, while every irreducible component of I over X_4 has dimension d − c + 3 = (d+2) + (1 − c) ≤ d+2 whenever c ≥ 1. Equality of the two source dimensions holds if and only if c = 1; if c ≥ 2 the jump incidence is strictly lower-dimensional than the B_3 incidence; if X_4 = ∅ only the P^2 case occurs. In particular, over any equidimensional base component that meets B_3, the h^0 = 4 jump stratum never produces a source component of strictly larger dimension than the h^0 = 3 incidence. (C3) Jump components are hyperelliptic non-primitive. Every irreducible component of I_4 is supported over the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus of B. (C4) Numerical test of the proposed 15+2=17 / pure-codimension-4 decomposition. The candidate arithmetic dim B = 15 with fibre dimension 2 giving source dimension 17 and ambient codimension 21−17 = 4 in M_{6,6} is compatible with the stratified source geometry of (C1)–(C2) if and only if the relevant base component lies in B_3 (so relative fibre dimension is 2, not 3) and has dimension 15. The same arithmetic is not, by itself, a proof that any component of B has dimension 15, that the classifying map of incidence data to M_{6,6} is generically finite, that the image is pure of codimension 4, that no larger component exists over special-curve or unbalanced loci, or that the reduced-support open is dense on every fibre. Consequently the proposed pure codimension-4 dominant-component decomposition survives only as a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15, and is refuted as an unconditional theorem deduced from the H0 stratification alone. The alternative jump arithmetic dim B + 3 is possible only for base components contained in B_4, and emptiness of B_4 remains open. (C5) Ordered reduced fibres. Each geometric fibre of tilde I_k → B_k is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1; nonemptiness is not implied by χ(L)=1. (C6) Openness obstruction to a closed pure-codimension-4 model. The balanced reduced-support open of I (equivalently of tilde I after the finite étale S_6-torsor of (H4)) is open in I and is not closed. Identifying that open piece with a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} is incompatible with its open nature without a separate closure and special-locus analysis. No claim is made about dim B, stabilizers, stack-level full faithfulness into M_{6,6}, image purity, unbalanced components, lci/Gysin structure, or any Hodge/Tate conclusion.
